aav-francia32-f17.summary: Sega reports the bishop's bad nature and leaning to the opposite party, out of limping religion rather than politics, and says he will temporise, showing feelings for and against him while stirring the parties to tell all they know.

aav-francia32-f71.summary: Sega on Mayenne writing something good for him to Rome, the protection of the Duke of Bavaria, the long-awaited "pomo", and a cause misrepresented by both sides.

system: Meister key 65: letters as digit pairs, vowels as signs on the pair or on a single digit, nulls, code letters and symbols for common words, three-digit nomenclator
